reply:
Open [Seed Library Desk](<TEMP>/T/selfrec-work-<SESSION>/index.html) in your browser. It works offline and starts with Snow Pea P26-01 at 17 packets, Calendula C26-02 at 9, and Bush Bean B25-04 at 4.

Volunteers can search by variety or lot, record checkouts and donations, and enter a shelf count with a short correction reason. Undo keeps both the original entry and its reversal visible in the lot history. Lots with three packets or fewer are flagged, and the full shelf list prints with space for handwritten counts. The app never asks for patron names.

Stock and history are saved in the current browser profile. Use the same profile and file location each shift. I verified the workflows offline, including reload persistence, simultaneous checkout attempts, and printing the full list while the catalog was filtered.
